_note: Studio Ledger, newest first. Curated by hand from each venture's git history: one plain-English line per shipped milestone. `updated` is the date shown under the table.

entries.text: Live boards fall back to the last good data instead of failing, and bots no longer burn the flight-data quota.
Paid plans switched on: Stripe billing, Xero Payroll sync on Pro, monthly pay calendars.
Timesheet records: approved hours freeze, every change needs a reason, date-range export.
Route pages for international flights into Australia, such as Dubai to Sydney.
Public verify page, so a buyer holding a report link can check the supplier’s figures.
Payment confirmation from Stripe became the only thing that can save a reporting period.
Emissions ledger recalculated on the server and hash-chained from one period to the next.
Guide pages for 15 Australian airports, linked from every board.
Searchable index of 320 Safeguard Mechanism facilities, each with its own page.
Postcode pages built from Clean Energy Regulator solar and battery data.
Guide to the January 2027 step-down in the federal battery rebate.
Homepage rebuilt around one decision: what a battery should really cost this home.
2,811 postcode pages for rooftop solar and batteries, rebuilt from CER data.
Boards refresh every 60 seconds; airborne flights show altitude and speed.
First commit: a weekly roster grid with CSV export.
